notes:
- Two new PvP kits: Respawn Anchor (Ship, Left behind, Fallen King) and Cart (Creeper, Bomber, Nuke), with their icons.
- Seven new level 4 ranks: Legendary Knight, Golden one, Steve, Fallen Angel, Reborned, Conductor and Living Shield, next to Harry Potter and True Mace Master.
- The Iris Client app for your phone: leaderboards, player profiles, friends with who is online, capes and news.
- Android gets the app as a download. On iPhone, open the app page in Safari and add it to the home screen.
- Link your phone from Friends in the launcher: press the phone button and type the code in the app. No Microsoft sign-in on the phone.
